messages:

Subject: Order Form + Security exhibit — clarifications on audit language

Hi Ava / Laura,

Thanks for the draft order form and the security exhibit. A few points came up from our security and procurement teams that we need clarified before procurement will sign:

- SOC 2 evidence: can Redwood provide the latest SOC 2 report and a short summary of scope (systems included, date, auditor)? procurement wants that attached to the order form.
- Penetration test: the exhibit references "penetration testing with reasonable notice." We need specifics: minimum notice, whether remote-only tests are acceptable, whether privileged access will be requested.
- Audit rights / inspection: we cannot accept unrestricted inspection. We prefer a bounded inspection model (recorded read-only sessions or snapshot evidence).
- Evidence cadence: procurement would like a suggested cadence (weekly sample bundle? monthly?) and an owner at Redwood to send items.

Attached is a short spreadsheet with our questions (MedAlign_Security_Questions.xlsx). Can you propose a short mutual action plan and dates for the pen-test window? Procurement is aiming to sign by mid-May if the security items are resolved.

Thanks,
Amanda Li
VP IT, MedAlign Health
amanda.li@medalign.com

Attachments: MedAlign_Security_Questions.xlsx

Subject: Re: Order Form + Security exhibit — clarifications on audit language

Amanda — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and a proposed plan below; Laura/Neha/Marcus copied to own the follow-ups.

1) SOC 2: we will attach the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (summary + bridge) to the order form. I've attached the summary now (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf) — we will provide the full report under NDA / secure link once procurement confirms.

2) Pen-test specifics: we propose a remote-only pen-test window (to limit on-prem access) and a 14-calendar-day notice minimum. Redwood will not provide privileged console credentials; instead, we provide ephemeral staging access where needed and monitored sessions. Marcus will coordinate the test plan and scope.

3) Audit/inspection: we can support a bounded inspection model — recorded read-only sessions, scoped to non-production staging, and a maximum of 3 business days of active evidence delivery (unless otherwise agreed). We will not support unbounded direct access to production systems.

4) Evidence cadence & owner: proposed cadence = weekly evidence bundle for the first 4 weeks post-onboard (then monthly snapshots thereafter). Owner: Neha (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai) will be the evidence owner who packages and sends the bundles.

5) Mutual action plan & timing: proposed pen-test window options: Apr 26–30 or May 10–14 (we can accommodate either). If procurement signs by mid-May we will prioritize May window.

Next steps:
- Laura: please confirm the precise contract language we can accept for inspection/pen-test.
- Marcus: prepare a short pen-test ops note (scope/what we will/we won't provide).
- Amanda: please confirm which pen-test window your team prefers and the procurement contact for signature.

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

Folks — quick legal note and suggested redline approach. (On Wed, 7 Apr 2027 12:04:00 -07:00 Ava Chen wrote: — see below for context).

Suggested contract language (high level):
- Audit rights: "Customer may request access to audit artifacts and observable sessions limited to non-production environments only, subject to Redwood's reasonable operational security controls and with at least 14 calendar days' notice. Such access shall be performed in read-only mode and may be recorded for security and compliance purposes."
- Penetration testing: "Customer may conduct a single penetration test per 12-month period against a dedicated staging environment following a mutually-agreed scope. Redwood will provide ephemeral, monitored access as required. No privileged production credentials will be provided."
- Evidence cadence: include a schedule: weekly bundles for 4 weeks post-activation and monthly thereafter; evidence types = SOC 2 summary, control descriptions, select logs (redacted), and configuration snapshots.

We should push back on language that allows "unrestricted audit rights" or undefined "in-person inspections." I marked suggested edits in OrderForm_Redlines_v2.docx and flagged the clauses I want Neha to verify ops feasibility on.

Neha — can you confirm the evidence list below is operationally feasible and highlight anything we cannot provide or that requires additional runbook work?
Marcus — need your pen-test ops note by Friday; include expected access model and hard stop times to protect customer production.

I'll aim to keep the Redlines doc short so procurement can quickly accept if they are comfortable with bounded inspection.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
